g.text: Let agents iterate inside explicitly gated stages
Coinbase’s framework places bounded draft/check/refine loops inside a forward-moving policy workflow.
Invented draft: $120k income − $84k expenses = $36k arithmetic difference; not suitability or permission.

Specify the allowed inputs, checkable output, iteration budget and human takeover condition. The loop can improve a draft while the outer workflow waits for the required acceptance or approval. Faster generation can shift the bottleneck to review rather than remove it.

The invented annual packet below subtracts $84k recorded expenses from $120k income: $36k is only an arithmetic difference. It establishes neither disposable capacity nor suitability. Review the facts, gaps, assumptions and conclusions before the work can be considered accepted.

Range preserves planner review; Perpetual binds approval to an exact payload. Accepting a draft is not permission to send or transact. A separate enforcing boundary checks user, case, resource and action, and retains the approval and outcome evidence.
Sources: Coinbase · Range · Perpetual | Reviewed October 25, 2026
